changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Glossary_All] AS select A.ObjectID as ID, A.ID as AssetID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentID, A.TypeID as ArtifactTypeID, A.DisplayValue, A.TypeName as ArtifactType, A.CreatedOn, coalesce(A.UpdatedOn, A.CreatedOn) as UpdatedOn, '' as KeyHash, S.Value as CurrentScore, cast(S.Value * 100 as int) as CurrentScorePct from AssetDetail A left join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 3 outer apply ( select max(EffectiveDate) as EffectiveDate from [metrics].[Score] where [AssetUid] = A.[Uid] and EffectiveDate <= getutcdate() ) MS left join metrics.Score S on S.AssetUid = A.[Uid] and S.EffectiveDate = MS.EffectiveDate where A.AssetTypeClass = 1
